title: Identification of Key Genes and Pathways Associated with Hepatosplenic T-Cell Lymphoma (HSTCL) by Bioinformatics Analysis.
authors: Du, Jun; Lu, Guang; Xu, Bin; Han, Xin-Le; Mou, Wei-Wei
one_liner_zh: 该文通过生物信息学分析筛选肝脾T细胞淋巴瘤差异表达基因及通路，虽涉及转录因子活性注释，但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题核心无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Prognosis of Hepatosplenic T-Cell Lymphoma (HSTCL) is very poor, while the molecular mechanism of this disease has rarely been investigated and remains mysterious. The aim of the study is to screen differentially expressed genes (DEGs) of patients with HSTCL and normal controls, explore the pathogenesis, and provide guidance for the gene diagnosis and precise treatment of HSTCL. METHODS: The genetic chip data GSE57520 of HSTCL was searched from the GEO database, and the quality control and DEGs screening were performed through BART online tools. In addition, FunRich software was used to perform gene enrichment and pathway analysis on the screened DEGs. Subsequently protein interaction network (PPI) was constructed via the STRING database and analyzed using the visual module of Cytoscape software. RESULTS: A total of 4,759 DEGs were obtained, including 2,501 up-regulated genes and 2,258 down-regulated genes (p < 0.05). The analysis of gene ontology (GO) showed that DEGs in cytology component (CC) mainly involved cytoplasm, nucleus, plasma membrane, Golgi apparatus, lysosome, and endoplasmic reticulum. Besides, DEGs in molecular function (MF) mainly included transcription factor activity, catalytic activity, transporter activity, transcription regulator activity, receptor signaling pathway complex, receptor activity. Moreover, DEGs in biological processes (BP) are mainly involved in base regulation, transport, energy pathways, metabolism, protein metabolism, and apoptosis. The results of the Kyoto Gene and Genome Encyclopedia (KEGG) analysis showed that the DEGs mainly include TRAIL, Beta1 integrin, integrin family, proteoglycan, S1P, and ErbB. Combined with Cytoscape software cytoHubba plug-in, protein interaction network (PPI) analysis showed that KIF20A, DLGAP5, PBK, TOP2A, ASPM, NEK2, KIF14, and DEPDC1B were the most abundant core genes. Module analysis showed that the three gene modules with the highest scores were mainly related to mitosis, epithelial cell adhesion and signal transduction, and the process of DNA damage. CONCLUSIONS: The DEGs of HSTCL patients versus healthy control groups were obtained through a variety of bioinformatics methods. KIF20A and DLGAP5 may become potential therapeutic targets for HSTCL. Also, the most abundant signaling pathway in DEGs was the tumor necrosis factor-related apoptosis-inducing ligand (TRAIL) - related pathway. Besides, related genes and expression characteristics of HSTCL pathogenesis were reanalyzed from distinctive perspectives, which might provide specific diagnostic markers and targeted therapy for HSTCL.
abstract_zh: 背景：肝脾T细胞淋巴瘤（HSTCL）的预后极差，而该疾病的分子机制鲜有研究且仍属未知。本研究旨在筛选HSTCL患者与正常对照者之间的差异表达基因（DEGs），探讨其发病机制，并为HSTCL的基因诊断和精准治疗提供指导。方法：从GEO数据库中检索HSTCL的基因芯片数据GSE57520，并通过BART在线工具进行质量控制和DEGs筛选。此外，使用FunRich软件对筛选出的DEGs进行基因富集和通路分析。随后，通过STRING数据库构建蛋白质相互作用网络（PPI），并使用Cytoscape软件的可视化模块进行分析。结果：共获得4,759个DEGs，包括2,501个上调基因和2,258个下调基因（p < 0.05）。基因本体论（GO）分析显示，细胞学组分（CC）中的DEGs主要涉及细胞质、细胞核、质膜、高尔基体、溶酶体和内质网。此外，分子功能（MF）中的DEGs主要包括转录因子活性、催化活性、转运体活性、转录调节因子活性、受体信号通路复合物和受体活性。再者，生物过程（BP）中的DEGs主要涉及基础调控、转运、能量通路、代谢、蛋白质代谢和凋亡。京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）分析结果显示，DEGs主要包括TRAIL、Beta1整合素、整合素家族、蛋白聚糖、S1P和ErbB。结合Cytoscape软件的cytoHubba插件，蛋白质相互作用网络（PPI）分析显示，KIF20A、DLGAP5、PBK、TOP2A、ASPM、NEK2、KIF14和DEPDC1B是最丰富的核心基因。模块分析显示，得分最高的三个基因模块主要与有丝分裂、上皮细胞黏附和信号转导以及DNA损伤过程相关。结论：通过多种生物信息学方法获得了HSTCL患者与健康对照组之间的DEGs。KIF20A和DLGAP5可能成为HSTCL的潜在治疗靶点。此外，DEGs中最丰富的信号通路是肿瘤坏死因子相关凋亡诱导配体（TRAIL）相关通路。同时，从独特视角重新分析了HSTCL发病机制的相关基因和表达特征，这可能为HSTCL提供特异性诊断标志物和靶向治疗。
